benchmark.benchmark_scope: Public, reproducible regression benchmark for maritime retrieval, official-source routing, jurisdiction/date applicability, evidence refusal, and live-data boundaries. It is not a field user study or a claim of worldwide knowledge completeness.

split_policy.validation: 25 historical regression cases retained for compatibility and top-k selection
split_policy.test: 35 additional fixed cases used for reproducible v1 release acceptance
split_policy.reporting_rule: Verified release metrics use test cases only; this partition exposed engineering defects during v1 acceptance and must not be described as untouched held-out data

latency.scope: single-process local measurement; not a production SLA
single-process local measurement; not a production SLA

verified_metrics.required_qualifier: fixed repository benchmark over registered public/curated maritime sources; test partition is release acceptance, not untouched held-out data, a field user study, production KPI, or global-coverage claim
